newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 21.875 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 21.875 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates remained steady on Thursday after being quoted in a relatively wide range of between 21.625 to 22.125 percent, traders said.
"There was a slight rise by the end of trading, but it did not materialise in actual deals," said Jozsef Laczi of ING Bank.
Overnight rates closed at 21.875 percent, unchanged from Wednesday, and present levels were seen appropriate with little reason for significant movements in either direction.
